vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-44228

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress MOVEit Transfer SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Progress MOVEit Transfer contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could lead to escalated privileges and unauthorized access.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: Extensively exploited by FIN7 and CL0P ransomware syndicate.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Information Disclosure Vulnerability (Citrix Bleed)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway contain an information disclosure vulnerability allowing session token exfiltration.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-4966

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A command injection vulnerability in web components of Ivanti Connect Secure allows authenticated administrator command execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: Used in targeted APT intrusion campaigns.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Netlogon Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (Zerologon)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists when an attacker establishes a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel to a domain controller.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: Critical Active Directory Domain Controller elevation vector.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows SMBv1 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (EternalBlue)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Server Message Block 1.0 (SMBv1) protocol.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: Weaponized in WannaCry and NotPetya ransomware operations.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Authentication bypass vulnerability in ConnectWise ScreenConnect allowing an attacker to create new administrative accounts.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: Rapid exploitation leading to ransomware deployments.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Barracuda Email Security Gateway Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A remote command injection vulnerability in Barracuda ESG allows execution of system commands.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Replace compromised ESG appliances.
vulnerabilities.notes: Targeted espionage campaign exploitation.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (Follina)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: MSDT vulnerability executed when called using the URL protocol from an application such as Word.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2022-30190

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (PrintNightmare)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Print spooler service improperly performs privileged file operations allowing full SYSTEM execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: Active privilege escalation and domain compromise vector.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS and iPadOS Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: An app may be able to modify sensitive kernel state in Apple iOS.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: Targeted zero-click spyware payload component.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server Broken Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to create unauthorized Confluence administrator accounts.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: Observed exploited in enterprise credential harvesting.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS XE Software Web UI Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to create an account with privilege level 15 access.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Disable HTTP Server feature or apply updates.
vulnerabilities.notes: Widespread enterprise edge router compromise.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (NotProxyLogon)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary PowerShell commands on Exchange servers.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: Used in Play and LockBit ransomware campaigns.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server SSRF Vulnerability (ProxyLogon)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Unauthenticated SSRF vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: Mass exploitation across global enterprise email servers.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Spring Framework Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (Spring4Shell)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Spring Framework MVC and WebFlux applications running on JDK 9+ allow remote code execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: Class loader manipulation vulnerability.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Authentication bypass vulnerability in web components of Ivanti Connect Secure.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor mitigation and update.
vulnerabilities.notes: Chained with CVE-2024-21887 for unauthenticated RCE.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Heap-based buffer overflow in SSL-VPN component allows remote unauthenticated code execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: Enterprise VPN gateway compromise vector.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OpenSSL Buffer Overflow Vulnerability (X.509 Email Address)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Buffer overrun can be triggered in X.509 certificate verification during name constraint checking.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: High severity cryptographic library vulnerability.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Command injection in GlobalProtect feature of PAN-OS allows root command execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor updates per vendor instructions.
vulnerabilities.notes: Exploited by nation-state actors for firewall compromise.
